## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/gravy42/profitshare/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for what each of these means.

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` is clean, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build`, then `npm run browsers`, passes
- [ ] An engine change has a test
- [ ] The sample budget still totals $805,312.06 (or this pull request says why it moved)
- [ ] Only invented names and content: no real people, budgets, scripts or photos
- [ ] No new dependency, or its licence is named above
- [ ] The app fetches nothing new from the network, and the content security policy still passes
- [ ] Words on screen are plain English, with no programmer terms and no em-dashes
- [ ] Every new field and button has a name, and nothing pressable is under 24px
- [ ] A rate, a date or legal wording comes with its source and the date it was checked
- [ ] A change to what a project file holds follows `docs/file-format.md`
- [ ] A bullet for today's date is added to `CHANGELOG.md`
